# Affiliate Guidance

> বাংলায় Affiliate Marketing শেখার premium platform — শূন্য থেকে শুরু করে প্রথম $1000 আয় পর্যন্ত complete গাইড, hand-picked tools, এবং real case studies।

Affiliate Guidance helps Bangla-speaking learners start and grow their affiliate marketing income with step-by-step guides, tool reviews, and honest recommendations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform, featured guides, and recommended tools.
- [About](/about): Who runs Affiliate Guidance and the editorial approach.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach out for collaboration, feedback, or questions.
- [Guest Post](/guest-post): Write for Affiliate Guidance — guidelines and submission.
- [Sponsored](/sponsored): Sponsored partnership and advertising options.

## Blog

- [Blog](/blog): Latest tutorials, guides, and case studies on affiliate marketing in Bangla.
- [Categories](/categories): Browse posts by topic (SEO, blogging, monetization, tools).

## Tools

- [All Tools](/tools): Curated tools for affiliate marketers — hosting, SEO, keyword research, email marketing.
- [Hosting](/tools/hosting): Web hosting recommendations for affiliate sites.
- [SEO Tools](/tools/seo): SEO software for ranking affiliate content.
- [Keyword Research](/tools/keyword): Keyword research tools.
- [Email Marketing](/tools/email): Email service providers for list building.
